name: The Windwatcher
summary: Warriors who have mastered the berserker stance are sent north to find The Windwatcher. After the Affray on Fray Island, Klannoc Macleod points them toward a weapon worthy of their fury.

sections.title: A Weapon for a Berserker
sections.body: You have survived the Affray on Fray Island and learned the berserker stance from Klannoc Macleod. Now Klannoc sends you far from the Barrens coast, across continents, to find a solitary craftsman who can forge an exceptional weapon.

sections.title: The Hermit on the Riverbank
sections.body: Bath'rah the Windwatcher lives beside the river that runs north past Tarren Mill. His camp rests among stone ruins in the contested land between the Alterac Mountains and the blighted Western Plaguelands. The troll hermit crafts weapons and commands potent elemental shamanism. He waits for warriors determined to forge a weapon of great power.

faq.q: Who sends you to find the Windwatcher?
faq.answer: Klannoc Macleod sends you north after you survive the Affray on Fray Island and learn the berserker stance.
Bath'rah is a troll hermit, master weaponsmith, and powerful shaman living in the wilderness between the Alterac Mountains and the Western Plaguelands.
Bath'rah camps near ancient ruins on the eastern bank of the river that flows north past Tarren Mill, near the border of Alterac and the Western Plaguelands.

faq.q: Why does Klannoc send warriors to Bath'rah?
aliases: what is the purpose of this quest
faq.answer: Klannoc sends warriors to Bath'rah because those who master the berserker stance need an exceptional weapon, and Bath'rah knows both smithing and elemental shamanism.

faq.q: What comes after speaking with Bath'rah?
aliases: what is next after the windwatcher
faq.answer: After you speak with Bath'rah, you face the elemental Cyclonian and gather rare materials to craft a potent weapon.

faq.q: Is this journey safe for a traveler coming from the Barrens?
faq.answer: The journey is perilous. You travel through the Hillsbrad foothills into contested northern lands, where Syndicate hideouts, aggressive mountain predators, and the deadly blight of the Western Plaguelands threaten you.

angles.text: As a warrior, you have mastered the berserker stance on Fray Island and now seek a powerful weapon forged through elemental craft.
As a troll, you can see how troll shamans and weapon crafters preserve mystical knowledge amid Lordaeron's broken ruins, knowledge warriors of every heritage revere.
